messages.content: Use only the supplied evidence to fulfill the job. Output only JSON {"trail":["code1","code2"],"print_line":"latestCode/seal/footer"}. trail lists the actual print code changes from first to last, no duplicate acknowledgements. print_line is a single label ready to print, literal values separated by slash without spaces. Use UNKNOWN for each unavailable value. Distinguish global footer updates from job-local rules.

Deliver the Alder print label. Evidence:
{"transcript":[{"id":1,"user":"Open the Alder print job. Start its print code at K14; its seal is S58, only for this job. Set the standing footer on every workspace job to M16.","answer":"Alder is open with print code K14 and job-only seal S58, and the workspace-wide footer is now M16."},{"id":2,"user":"Open the Birch print job. Its print code starts at P83; stamp S31 on this job only.","answer":"Birch is open with print code P83 and job-only seal S31."},{"id":3,"user":"On the Alder proof replace its earlier print code with N72. Retain its seal. Confirm the change.","answer":"Alder's print code is now N72, replacing K14, and its job-only seal S58 is retained."},{"id":4,"user":"For Birch replace the print code with J26. Separately the standing footer on ALL workspace jobs is now M94, superseding the earlier one.
